title: Volume 1 Chapter 3: Pedicure 2
content: “Ah, okay, I got it—”
I found myself agreeing, pushed by her enthusiasm.
As soon as Sayori heard my response, she quickly returned to the circle of girls. Questions like “What’s going on?” and “What did you want to talk about?” bombarded her.
“It’s personal, so it’s a secret!”
She replied with an answer that could easily lead to misunderstandings.
Sayori hadn’t told anyone that I could do nails. It was unusual for her, someone who was generally open about everything, but it seemed that this only deepened the misunderstandings.
“...Are you really just friends?”
Miyabe asked with a wry smile. See? I told you!
“...Friends.”
I struggled to respond, but in the end, that was all I could say.
As my distance with Sayori grew closer, my position in class became more precarious.
Maybe she wasn’t just an ordinary girl, but a monster invading my daily life.
“Hey, can we stop talking in class?”
During the lunch break when she called me out to discuss something—
I told Sayori that while we spread out our lunch on the rooftop.
“Huh? Why?”
Sayori looked puzzled as she bit into her bread.
Eating lunch together like this would likely deepen the misunderstandings even more.
“Why? Because weird rumors might start. I hardly had any connection with you, Sayori.”
“Rumors? I don’t care!”
She genuinely seemed unconcerned, which left me bewildered.
“If it’s a good rumor, I’d be happy, and if it’s a bad rumor, just let it be, right?”
“I care about it.”
“Don’t worry! If anyone says anything bad about Azuma-kun, I’ll set them straight!”
“That’s exactly what spreads the misunderstandings…”
I started to say, but stopped. Since Sayori didn’t care, it would be pointless to say it repeatedly.
“...I’d feel bad. If my actions tarnished Sayori’s reputation.”
In the end, that was the only way I could express it.
Am I being overly self-conscious? I wondered, glancing at Sayori’s expression—she wore her usual cheerful smile.
“Really? So, you’re worried about me, Azuma-kun?”
“Wha!? Not really, I mean… no, but…”
“Hehe♪ You don’t need to worry! As long as my really close friends understand me, that’s all that matters!”
I wondered if I was included in that group of close friends.
I was curious but didn’t have the courage to ask.
“...You should just explain it properly. That we’re just in a relationship where you ask me for nails.”
“No way!”
“Huh?”
As she swallowed her bite of bread, Sayori leaned in closer again.
“If everyone finds out you do nails, what do you think will happen!? It’ll be a disaster!”
“W-What do you mean…?”
“Of course, all the girls in class will start asking you to do their nails! No way, that’s absolutely not happening!”
“That’s not true.”
“Absolutely! You’ll be too busy and might even die from exhaustion!”
Why would you say that? Don’t just kill me off like that.
“If that happens, I won’t have time to do my nails, right?”
“...Maybe.”
“Ah! That attitude! See, that’s why it won’t work!”
In Sayori’s mind, my nail skills were already seen as something desirable, and it seemed like there would be a fierce competition among the girls for my attention.
That can’t be true. Sayori was just overestimating my abilities.
“Anyway! I won’t explain the situation to everyone in class! If they say anything after that, then so be it!”
“Why are you getting mad? Is it okay if they start rumors that we’re dating?”
“Just let them say it! I don’t care—oh!”
Sayori suddenly had a mischievous grin on her face as if she thought of something ridiculous.
“Or maybe we should really become a couple?”
“Wha!?”
“Ahaha! You’re totally panicking! Of course, I’m just joking!”
“Y-You…”
I still couldn’t grasp the gal’s way of joking.
Sayori was teasing me and laughing uncontrollably.
“But really, I don’t care about rumors! What’s more important is talking about my next nails, okay?”
“...Fine.”
Just like that, her expression shifted from laughter to seriousness as she looked at me.
When she made that face, I had no choice but to nod.
“So? What kind of nails do you want this time?”
“Ah, that! That’s what I wanted to discuss!”
Now that I think about it, I was originally called out for Sayori’s business.
While she casually chatted in class, using the rooftop for nail discussions was likely due to her strange delusion that I’d become popular among the girls.
“I want you to do my toes too!”
“Toes…”
She wanted me to do her toenails.
“Painting toes is… um, I think it’s called a pedicure?”
“Yeah, exactly! Can you do it?”
“Hmm…”
I tried to visualize it in my mind.
Sayori’s nails were unique, but I figured the strength of her nails wouldn’t be drastically different between her hands and feet.
It should be pretty much the same as doing her hands.
The issue was the posture—if I was painting her toes, I’d have to kneel down at her feet to work.
That would be an embarrassing sight if someone saw us. Even though no one else came to the garage, I still hesitated.
“...What about doing it yourself? I can at least prep the base for you.”
“No way! I want Azuma-kun to do it.”
Her answer was immediate.
“Doing it on your toes means you have to bend over and stretch your hands out like this to paint them nicely, right? It’s pretty tough!”
“Okay, okay. I’ll do it. So? What kind of polish do you want?”
Since painting was already a confirmed task, the question was about the paint.
“Yeah, that! That’s what I wanted to discuss! Actually, Mio-chan… the editor from the fashion magazine I’m working with suddenly asked me to do a swimsuit shoot…”
“A swimsuit shoot? It’s May now, right? Isn’t that something you should do earlier…?”

“Exactly! Normally, you’d do it six months in advance, but there seems to have been some trouble? The photos of the model they planned to use can’t be used anymore! So now we have to do the whole shoot in a hurry!”
“T-That sounds tough.”
There seemed to be various circumstances I didn’t understand.

“And since it’s a swimsuit, I’ll be showing my bare feet, right? I’ll wear sandals, but either way, my toes will be visible, right? There’s no way I can show my bare feet without nail polish! So, I want a pedicure…”
“Since it’s a swimsuit shoot, I want the pedicure and swimsuit design to match, you know?”
I understood that the shoot was challenging, but I still didn’t quite grasp the whole picture.
“So first, we should go pick out a swimsuit!”
“Is that how it’s going to be!?”
“It’s absolutely impossible if the swimsuit and nail designs don’t match!”
Is that really how it works?
If nails are part of fashion, it makes sense to want a unified theme or intention.
When modifying plastic models, having a consistent concept is crucial.
“I don’t really get it, but don’t they usually provide that kind of thing for the shoot?”
“Normally, yes, but this time they asked me to do it on short notice! They said I could prepare this year’s new swimsuits myself!”
I didn’t understand the circumstances of fashion magazine shoots, but it seemed like a pretty urgent situation.
However, instead of compromising, Sayori was determined to choose her swimsuit and the best nails to match for the shoot.
A reader model—she was basically an amateur, right? Yet her professionalism was impressive.
“Are you free after school today? You’re free, right!? Let’s go buy a swimsuit right away!”
“Wait, wait, hold on…”
Her thoughts and actions were too directly connected. It was hard to keep up.
“You can just pick out the swimsuits and nails you like!”
“Azuma-kun, you’re my nail artist, so I want to hear your opinion too!”
Ugh.
That makes some sense—at least it seems that way. That’s why I’m weak against her pressure.
“Right now, they’re selling swimsuits at the mall near the station~♪”
That’s a place I often go to for model supplies.
I remembered that I had run into Sayori there before.
But if I go to the swimsuit section with a girl, there will definitely be strange rumors—more than that, I’ve never experienced anything like it, so I feel really awkward.
“...Isn’t it a bit early? It’s May, after all?”
“It’s a little early, but if they’re selling them, we have to go now!”
Ah, this is something I can’t escape from. I can’t think of any excuses to decline.

I usually don’t pay much attention to her since I’m focused on my hands in the garage, and I don’t really make eye contact at school—but Sayori definitely has a figure that’s beyond what you’d expect from a high school girl.
A swimsuit—she’ll probably try it on.
I’m going to see a model-like girl in a swimsuit. Right now?
“If it’s what Azuma-kun likes… I could wear something really revealing for you!”
“I don’t like that!”
“Ahaha! Just kidding, just kidding~♪ Don’t get mad!”
My introverted self was already feeling uneasy about what was to come.
(I really came here…)
As Sayori said, the mall near the station had a seasonal swimsuit section set up.
“Alright! Let’s pick one!”
“You’re really pumped up…”
“Of course! Girls get excited about their favorite swimsuits!”
“I feel like I heard a similar line during the nail discussion…”
“Really? No way!? Then, um… anyway, anything you wear! I’ll get excited about it if it’s my favorite!”
“R-Right…”
The passion for total coordination, including nails, was incredible.
Well, she is modeling for a fashion magazine, so in a way, it’s only natural.
In no time, Sayori picked out about ten swimsuits and headed for the fitting room.
“Azuma-kun too! Come on!”
I was dragged along to the front of the fitting room with her swimsuits.
“I’m fine, really…”
“Give me your opinion!”
Once she said that, it turned into a fashion show featuring Sayori in swimsuits.
“First, I think a bikini would be good?”
She wore a flashy animal print bikini, giving off a quintessential gal vibe.
“This one-piece isn’t bad, but there’s no place for my tail to go.”
It was a revealing one-piece.
How was she wearing it without any holes? It seemed like she was forcing her tail out from where her legs were supposed to go.
Choosing a swimsuit as a demi-human seemed to be quite a challenge.
“This panda one might be a bit too mature? How should I match the nails?”
